children: Canada family entertainment firm's Q4 revenue from continuing operations fell 29% yr/yr
Adjusted EBITDA for Q4 was negative C$4 mln, down C$12 mln from prior year
Company, which owns franchises like Strawberry Shortcake and Teletubbies, repurchased and cancelled shares worth C$3.2 mln since launching NCIB
WildBrain expects fiscal 2027 revenue of C$270 mln to C$295 mln
Company sees fiscal 2027 Adjusted EBITDA of C$28 mln to C$32 mln
WildBrain expects Adjusted EBITDA to double from 2027 midpoint by end of fiscal 2029
LICENSING REVENUE DECLINE - Co said lower licensing agency revenues at WildBrain CPLG, due to timing differences and changes in partner relationships, weighed on Q4 revenue
CONTENT PRODUCTION SLOWDOWN - Co said lower live-action production activity and absence of major content delivery reduced Q4 content revenue
ADVERTISING REVENUE GROWTH - Co said higher direct advertising revenue drove growth in WildBrain Network in Q4
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "hold" and the breakdown of recommendations is no "strong buy" or "buy", 4 "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the entertainment production peer group is "buy."
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for WildBrain Ltd. is C$1.88, about 21% above its September 22 closing price of C$1.55
The stock recently traded at 34 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 213 three months ago
